primary_policy: Require an explicit single alpha1 or alpha2, one beta, gamma2 composition in BOTH target name and assay description, a specific protein-complex target, and no review flags. No union or completion of partial descriptions.
numeric_policy: Point-comparison counts require PRIMARY, finite value, exact '=' relation, reported compatible units and assay species, no ChEMBL potential_duplicate flag. All original rows remain available.
species_policy: Use the reported assay organism only, never fill it from target or prose. Conflicting organism evidence gives unknown and REVIEW; preserve each source separately.
pair_policy: Same compound, document, species, beta/gamma background, endpoint/type/unit/relation and subtype-masked recorded assay context; no averaging, ratios or claim of unreported conditions being equal.
existing_files_policy: Do not update existing files, including runs/LATEST_RUN.txt.
